messages.subject: RRO crashes with using base plotting package?
parts:
Hey there --

I downloaded RRO 3.2.0 today.  Mostly working great, but the base plotting package seems to be crashing my session, every time.

FWIW, I can use ggplot2 with no problem.  I'd like to avoid base plot as much as possible, but when following online examples for something I'm trying to learn, it's not always possible.

Here's my session which just crashed, and the top part of the Problem Details if it helps. Thanks!

parts:
Thanks for reporting this, Tyler!

I tried running your commands on my Macbook Pro (Yosemite 10.10.3) and wasn't able to reproduce the issue from Terminal, from the GUI app, or from RStudio. But the trace details you provided are helpful and we'll see if we can find clues there. Did you ever have similar issues with R from CRAN?

If anyone else encounters a similar problem please let us know on this group -- thanks.
